overview: Lucky Swap is an ICRC-1/ICRC-2 token app with an ICP swap pool, a treasury, and per-user wallets, now with a trusted integration API so an external game can move funds into the treasury, top up its prize pool, debit bets, and pay out winnings.
features: Swap ICP for Lucky tokens and back at a fixed rate
Per-user Lucky and ICP wallet with send and receive
Admin treasury with withdraw, mint, and burn controls
Trusted integration API for an external game to fund the treasury
Admin withdrawal from the treasury to top up a game prize pool
Bet debits and prize payouts applied directly to user wallets
Idempotent integration events with a queryable ledger of every fund movement
Integration guide page documenting every endpoint for game developers
